a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-08-27 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: Space. Declared and not confirmed in this snapshot: Enter. Absence of an observable change does not prove absence of effect — a generic DOM snapshot can prove a key does something, never that it does not.

props.name: label
props.description: REQUIRED. A switch with no label is a mystery toggle.

props.name: labelHidden
props.description: Keeps the label in the DOM but out of sight, as the Checkbox does — for a switch whose name is already on screen beside it.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the label, as the Checkbox and the reference — then the label is set in bold.

props.name: indicatorPlacement
props.description: Where the switch sits: before the label (the default) or after it, with the label and description on the left — the same name as the native RadioGroup.

props.name: checked / defaultChecked
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled. role="switch" is set for you.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Switch applies immediately; a Checkbox waits for the form to be submitted.
